title: Subdomains
subtitle: Create subdomains under this domain (e.g. blog.example.com) — each gets its own web directory.
confirm_delete:
Permanently delete the subdomain {{ad}}?

This removes:
• All files and folders (docroot)
• The SSL certificate
• The nginx configuration
• The DNS A record

THIS CANNOT BE UNDONE. Without a backup the files cannot be recovered.
ssl_installed_lets: SSL installed for {{ad}} (Let's Encrypt). It is now reachable over https://.
ssl_installed_self: SSL installed for {{ad}} (self-signed). It is now reachable over https://.
subdomain_help: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. E.g.: blog, shop, api.
info_note: ℹ️ The subdomain is registered in the web server immediately. For access, your domain's DNS (A record) must point to this server.
php_change_failed: Could not change the PHP version
php_locked_title: This account uses its own PHP-FPM service; the version follows the main domain
php_locked_note: This account runs its own PHP-FPM service, so subdomains share the main domain's PHP version. If you need a different version, change the main domain's PHP version — subdomains will follow it.
delete_note: Deleting removes ALL of the subdomain's files, its SSL certificate, its nginx configuration and its DNS record. This cannot be undone.
php_ayri_domain_note: If a subdomain needs a DIFFERENT PHP version, add it as a SEPARATE DOMAIN instead. A separate domain gets its own system user and its own PHP-FPM service, so it can run a PHP version independent of the main domain. Subdomains share the main domain's PHP service.
